title: Chile-lime Fish Sauce
description: Chile-lime Fish Sauce, a dipping sauce, recipe by Kasma Loha-unchit.
copyright: Copyright © 1998 Kasma Loha-unchit. All rights reserved.
author: Kasma Loha-unchit
ingredients: 3-5 Thai chiles, cut into very thin rounds with seeds
body:
One of the staple foods I never tire of eating is garlicky, crisp-fried fish served with this chile-lime fish sauce. In my childhood, I loved mixing steamed rice on my plate thoroughly with small bites of fried fish, crispy garlic, and the tangy fish sauce mixture - a very satisfying one-dish meal, better than any fried rice! (Learn more about Flavoring Food with Fish Sauce.)

Ingredients

  • 3-5 Thai chiles, cut into very thin rounds with seeds
  • 2 Tbs. Thai fish sauce (nahm bplah)
  • 1 Tbs. fresh lime juice
  • 1/2 tsp. granulated sugar

Mix above ingredients together.
